guard: cotal ps reports a partial census and exits non-zero instead of presenting one instance's seats as the whole space
why: The defect had two halves and each has its own mutation. Restoring the zero exit is the half a
script reads, so it is proven against the command's own status rather than against a helper.
Counting a refusing instance as one that reported restores the miscount the exit is derived
from. The last two hold the line the issue asked for: the split is decided on the structured
refusal code, and the code has to travel from the scatter to the renderer for the operator to
see it at all, which only the live run crosses.
No build step is needed: the suite imports the CLI from src, and nothing here mutates a package

mutations.name: the partial census exits 0 again
mutations.expectRed: EXITS NON-ZERO: a partial census is not a listing of the space
mutations.cell: `cotal ps` over this space EXITS NON-ZERO: a partial census is not a listing of the space
mutations.note: This is the shipped behaviour and reproduces the half of #1637 that only a script can see.

mutations.name: a refusing instance is counted as one that reported
mutations.expectRed: the refusal and the silence counted the same way
mutations.cell: ...so two did not, the refusal and the silence counted the same way
mutations.note: The refusal hides that instance's whole roster, so counting it as reported is the miscount the exit status is derived from.

mutations.name: the notice is withheld from a partial census
mutations.expectRed: a partial census produces a notice
mutations.cell: a partial census produces a notice
mutations.note: An exit code with no line beside it tells an operator at a terminal nothing about what is missing.

mutations.name: the contract split is decided on the message instead of the code
mutations.expectRed: a refusal whose MESSAGE reads like a mismatch but carries no code is not one either
mutations.cell: ...and a refusal whose MESSAGE reads like a mismatch but carries no code is not one either
mutations.note: The wording is operator copy; a renderer matched to its prose claims a split for any refusal that mentions a contract.

mutations.name: the scatter stops carrying the refusal code to the renderer
mutations.expectRed: naming the contract split once, with the pin, off the code the scatter carried
mutations.cell: ...and naming the contract split once, with the pin, off the code the scatter carried
mutations.note: The census keys on the code, so dropping it in the scatter leaves the operator with the per-row SPEC citation and no statement of the condition.
